supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.behavior: Compare original pay-as-you-go sealing with saving the full next23-YARN self-source recipe. Existing owned Epics reduce the remaining need. Forge-first saves ahead of styles; styles-first may exhaust cash. These are behavioral bounds, not telemetry or protocol limits.
assumptions.utility: Interest50% independently in each finite3-design catalog; no bot cosmetic utility. Same cohort/seed across alternatives; at most3 forge unlocks and3 styles each.
assumptions.denominator: All20-YARN grants and routine claims stay in the original claims/burn<=2 metric. Sealing still counts as an actual burn even if no forge completes. No retrospective metric change.
assumptions.completion: Report a separate outcome: interested accounts with at least1 forge. Sealed-but-never-forged is descriptive inventory, not proof of regret, dead money or failed sales. No arbitrary pass threshold is invented.
assumptions.authority: Recurring Epic supply is conditional on the source-code study; neither it nor this experiment authenticates campaign earning. Routine issuer and public activation remain disabled.
